about_the_game:
Demo Version - Your First Taste of Strategy, Seduction, and Collectible Thrills

Get a sneak peek at our bold new NSFW card battler with this limited-time demo.

💥 What’s Inside the Demo:

  • A hand-picked selection of starter and rare cards to build your first deck

  • 4 boss fights designed to test your strategy and unlock early rewards

  • A look into our card pack system - with a few packs to open for free

  • Private chats with 1 heroines - build relationships, unlock spicy scenes

  • Access to the core combat mechanics and early progression systems

This is not just a preview - it’s your chance to start collecting, battling, and connecting before the full game drops.

Your progress will carry over, so the smart moves you make now will give you a head start at launch.

Collect rare and epic cards by defeating elite bosses or completing challenges. Every card is a potential masterpiece-both a weapon and a trophy.

Beyond the battlefield, connect with in-game heroines through private chats and flirty dialogue. Make the right choices, deepen relationships, and unlock more intimate moments as you progress.

This demo offers a taste of everything the full game will deliver: thrilling strategy, stunning visuals, and a bold twist of romance.

Ready to play smart, collect hard, and flirt harder? Download the demo and take the first step into a world where every move counts-and every card might change your fate.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains explicit sexual content presented in a cartoon art style. It includes depictions of nudity, visible genitalia, and animated sex scenes. The content is intended for adults only and is not suitable for all audiences. The game does not include any content involving minors, sexual violence, or non-consensual acts.
